rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is clear or obvious.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 daap3 on3 hou2 ming4 hin2

rows.meaning: seeming, seeming but not necessarily real
rows.note: Use this for something that seems to have a quality or identity without asserting that it really does.

example.english: This person has an apparent air of professionalism, but actually knows nothing.
example.traditional: 呢個人貌似好專業，但其實乜都唔識。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jan4 maau6 ci5 hou2 zyun1 jip6 daan6 kei4 sat6 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1

rows.meaning: seeming, seeming but not necessarily real
rows.note: Use this before a noun such as 友誼 when the apparent quality is only superficial and may not be genuine.

example.english: This is only an apparent friendship, not a genuine one.
example.traditional: 呢段只係表面嘅友誼，唔算真心。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 zi2 hai6 biu2 min6 ge3 jau5 ji4 m4 syun3 zan1 sam1
